reasoning_scale.1: One explicit local rule or simple comparison.
reasoning_scale.2: Multiple observations, a relation or a short history must guide action.
reasoning_scale.3: Coupled planning, systematic experimentation, extended history or ambiguity.

execution_scale.1: Inspection/simple navigation or one accessible transfer.
execution_scale.2: A small number of placements or moderate geometric alignment.
execution_scale.3: Long carrying horizon, stacking, cloth/door manipulation, narrow alignment or repeated controlled trials.

reporting.recommended: Average within each populated subclass, then within family, then average the six families.

followups.action: Resolve native access uncertainties before interpreting failures as difficulty. T46 new audit reached 28,709 SE2 states but no sampled target stance was connected; zero IK calls means no arm-limit conclusion.
Measure all ramp trials and verify different physical conditions can change the correct winner. Keep three conditions until that evidence supports pruning.
Design a two-room/two-pickup derived training condition while retaining four/six-room challenge definitions. Do not silently change current evaluation tasks or in-flight trials.
Consider a four-object/two-category/one-request history condition; keep T38 nine-object version. T39 remains an extension until such a protocol is authored and verified.

Use archived matched positive/negative or identity-swap controls for scientific paired evaluation, grouped under their mechanism. Do not inflate the main task count or claim sensitivity from one retained branch.
All historical QA sources say outside; verify current native initial state and add an already-inside diagnostic control before claiming balanced action/no-action coverage.
